inventedEvidence.evidence: 'Doesn't get deeper during or after cycles, and isn't dirty or smelly'

rationale: The assistant asked the right questions (clarity and amount of water), then correctly reassured that a cupful of clean water in the sump is normal, recommending no part. However, the final reply states as fact that the water 'doesn't get deeper' and 'isn't smelly', which the customer never said in the conversation, so it asserts unsupported evidence even though the ground truth fact bank happens to agree on the level. It also never asked whether the level was rising or whether there were error codes, so it was somewhat overconfident.
